name: Monte-Carlo method (MCM)
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过随机抽样及重复计算估计统计量的方法。
usage_overview: 在随机动力分析中，通过对参数或激励反复抽样并计算响应，估计响应统计量、概率分布或平均响应谱；也常用作数值比较基准，检验代表性样本方法、虚拟激励法等计算所得的统计结果。

complete_examples.text: With regard to the random analysis of train-track/bridge interactions, there are mainly three types of methods, i.e., Monte-Carlo method (MCM) [6,20,21] , pseudo-excitation method (PEM) [17,18,22,23] and probability density evolution method (PDEM) [16,24] , where the system parameters or excitations, e.g, track irregularities and seismic motions, etc.
To validate the effectiveness of TIPM, Monte-Carlo method (MCM) is applied to select the track irregularity sets ade-quately.
To illustrate the efficiency and accuracy of this proposed method, a well-known and robust method, Monte-Carlo Method (MCM), is applied in the validation.
